prompt.project_info: Create a playful fisheye portrait of an approved adult woman sitting safely inside a shopping cart in a supermarket aisle.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long dark-brown hair in loose low pigtails, playful wink and slight smile, wearing a black opaque top, blue-white plaid shirt tied at the waist, white scrunched socks, and chunky white sneakers.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject seated securely in the cart, legs extended toward the camera with controlled wide-angle foreshortening, finger-frame gesture around one eye, colorful generic snack packaging, fluorescent aisle lights, tiled floor, and metal cart.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even retail lighting with soft shadows, vibrant carefree social-media mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic digital photography, portrait 9:16, 8-10mm fisheye feel, deep depth of field, sharp subject and background, realistic proportions despite controlled lens distortion.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman sits safely inside a wire shopping cart in a brightly lit supermarket aisle, wearing an opaque black top, blue-white plaid shirt tied at the waist, white scrunched socks, and chunky white sneakers. Use controlled 8-10mm fisheye perspective, playful wink and finger-frame gesture, colorful generic snack shelves, fluorescent lights, and vibrant realistic detail. No identifiable product branding.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, unsafe cart placement, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, distorted face, extreme anatomy errors, extra fingers, unreadable brand text, logos, watermark, public figure likeness.
